# Corrected dispersion: publication wrapper

Claim type: bounded_theorem

This projection preserves all 1049 lines of the accepted proof below,
SHA-256 `402cbc03585ac1cf0fc32facfc18b889de09a2fc9b3bb1449dfda47beb813c0d`.
Only this wrapper and the closing source/status appendix are new. The exact
source assembly was accepted by ordinary root review. These publication
wrappers and the identity-only tool remain subject to separate exact review;
no scientific execution or retained-status decision occurs in preparation.

The theorem fixes positive mass and velocity, the supplied one-dimensional
carrier, ordinary one-sided cells, and a fixed finite selfadjoint even CAR
polynomial in fixed smooth compact real inputs. Each kinetic order is chosen
before the spacing limit. The comparison is between the entire placed actual
density and low evolution of its unconditional high partial trace with high
vacuum appended. The effective potential is the exact finite-spacing
compression, including its high contractions. The physical-band operator
domains and the different full-low effective domain keep their stated roles.

The first kinetic correction is the displayed quadratic-in-spacing term in
the original proof. For every fixed order J, its sufficient growing window
has T_c c^(2J+2) tending to zero. The proof's first interacting-mean argument
retains its older valid power 1/(4J+7). The companion
moment-sensitive note
later obtains 1/(4J+6) under its explicit moment and commutator resources.
The older proof is not rewritten to contain that later argument.

This proof was recovered after a transport failure; the recovery worker saw
the predecessor's draft. Its exclusion of the new root candidates and its
disclosed earlier smooth-high exposure remain separate facts. Later complete
comparison and ordinary root acceptances are bound in the appendix. None
establishes model diversity, a fresh proof by this assembly worker, formal
analytic verification or a transitive audit.

Original titles, exposure disclosures, failed routes, and statements that
review or potential identification was pending remain historical statements
at their original freeze. The full accepted body begins immediately below.

All 600 lines of the accepted core follow without alteration, SHA-256

chronology. Root accepted the exact source assembly; this publication
wrapper and identity-only tool await separate exact review. No scientific
rerun or retained-status action occurs in publication preparation.

The order and all input smearings are fixed before the spacing limit. The
remainder constants depend on the chosen order, positive mass and velocity,
finitely many weighted Sobolev norms, and the fixed polynomial prescription.
The maps retain the actual one-sided cell phase, half-density, frame and
arcsine argument transport. The real CAR field norm, grading and two-point
normalization are literal; high-vacuum contractions are included in the exact
compression even when they are beyond every fixed power for these inputs.

The coefficients give bounded even selfadjoint operators on the full unital
low Fock representation. Compact physical support of the original input does
not by itself make every effective coefficient exactly local. No new spatial
classification or propagation result is included in this milestone.

The core establishes the coefficient/potential remainder. Its original
reservation about growing-time dynamics is preserved. The later accepted
comparison separately identifies the bounded same-kinetic replacement cost;
the appendix states that boundary without importing a kinetic domain proof
into this unchanged body. The companion corrected-dispersion and moment
theorems retain their own carrier, regularity, state and time assumptions.

The derivation excluded the then-new root candidates but was exposed to the
earlier first-order coefficient through its allowed smooth-high sources.
The later comparison is source-exposed. This assembly reuses exact accepted
source coverage and makes no fresh independent mathematical-review claim.

# Moment-sensitive corrected dynamics: publication wrapper

Claim type: bounded_theorem

The following 731-line core is byte-identical to
`8361667a12e01be16c40b01a3fc6aff14512fb1fed6f29ccdd9cac2e4c408c09`.
The source assembly added scope and chronology prose and was accepted
by ordinary root review. Its new publication wrappers and identity-only tool
await separate exact review; no scientific execution or retained decision
occurs in this publication preparation.

The stationary theorem keeps the interacting spectral weight through a
global integer graph comparison and bounded right-weight interpolation.
The independent spectral exponent and the root Hilbert--Schmidt exponent
obey s_independent = 2 s_root. The square of the root's Hilbert--Schmidt
moment norm is the spectral moment Tr(rho B^(2 s_root)). The hypotheses require uniform named moment and
commutator resources at a fixed kinetic order, not just boundedness of an
arbitrary potential or compact support of a rough input.

For a first interacting mean, the kinetic error power is 1/(4J+6). This
improves the older valid normalized-window power 1/(4J+7) in the companion
corrected-dispersion body without altering that proof. The general theorem
also keeps its separate high-discard term, saturation of the kinetic power,
and sufficient window T_c c^(2J+2) tending to zero. The target uses the exact
compressed W_c and the moving initial low partial density. Every actual
spectral/moment assertion stays on the physical carrier; the full-low
effective extension has its own maximal free domain.

The independent core was frozen before exposure to the then-new moment root
and its phase control. Its shared earlier sources and same-family exposure
are disclosed in the body. The later accepted comparison found that the
separate root control's constant physical-spinor wording is false; an
explicit momentum-dependent positive eigenline fixes its placement. The
731-line core already uses a valid positive eigenline and requires no edit.
The original root control is archived unchanged with the exact precision
addendum. No repaired projection of that control is inserted into this note.

The following historical pending-review statements remain unchanged. This
assembly is integration of accepted sources, not a new independent proof or
fresh mathematical checking established by copying and hashing.
